items.summary: 3D part assembly aims to reconstruct a complete shape from a set of unassembled parts by predicting a rigid SE(3) transformation for each part. items.summary: Language-model agents that run long tasks often redo work they have already done: they re-issue a tool call they made earlier and get back exactly the same observation, a step that adds no new information. items.title: Using Python's pip to Manage Your Projects' Dependencies
items.description: What is pip? Learn how to use pip, Python's standard package manager, to install and manage packages that aren't part of the standard library.
items.summary: pip is the standard package manager for Python, used to install and manage libraries that aren’t part of the Python standard library . You use pip to manage dependencies and install packages from the Python Package Index (PyPI) .
